blocks.text: Prelates and princes applied to Sergius not only for the sake of his spiritual instructions, but also to receive from him teachers, who had been trained to perfection by his converse in solitude, and who in their turn might be capable of influencing others by their good example : for from the appearance of Sergius there began among us, as it were, a second era and development of monasticism; and in the ful- ness of its light our unhappy country, which had been suffering so long under the plague of the Tartars, revived.
blocks.locator: A History of the Church of Russia, chapter on Sergius, p62, paragraph beginning Prelates and princes

For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
